words.definition: A trip from one place to another.
words.example: Our journey to the mountains took two hours.

words.definition: A plan listing the places and times of a trip.
words.example: We checked the itinerary before leaving the hotel.

words.definition: The place someone is travelling to.
A place to stay while away from home.
words.example: We booked accommodation near the station.

words.definition: A sequence of steps for solving a problem.
words.example: The algorithm sorts the words alphabetically.
The database stores each learner's progress.

words.definition: A point where a person or system interacts with another system.
words.example: The application has a simple interface.

words.definition: A group of connected devices that exchange information.
words.example: The school network connects all the computers.

words.definition: A set of actions regularly followed.
words.example: Reading is part of my morning routine.

words.definition: A plan for how much money can be spent.
words.example: We made a budget for groceries.

words.definition: A short trip to complete a small task.
words.example: I ran an errand to collect a parcel.

words.definition: An arrangement to meet at a particular time.
words.example: My dentist appointment is on Friday.

words.definition: The natural place where an organism lives.
words.example: The forest is a habitat for many birds.

words.definition: The usual weather conditions of a region over a long period.
words.example: This region has a warm climate.

words.definition: A group of similar organisms that can reproduce with one another.
words.example: This lake contains several species of fish.

words.definition: The protection of nature and natural resources.
words.example: Wildlife conservation helps protect endangered animals.
